system: BTC Signal Pro Elite Advanced ML
model: Four-model vote: full-history logistic, recent-regime logistic, nearest-centroid and decision-stump ensemble
data_source: OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP Futures public OHLC candles
quote_asset_note: OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP and/or Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual Futures data; cross-exchange prices may differ.

adaptive_learning.method: bounded reliability weighting with 30-sample neutral prior; chronological matured forecasts only
adaptive_learning.note: This safely adapts ensemble blending; it does not retrain the underlying neural-network weights.

cost_aware_backtest.cost_assumption: 0.05% taker fee + 0.02% slippage per side; funding excluded
cost_aware_backtest.warning: Illustrative costs only; real spread, funding, fills and exchange fees may differ.

validation_gate.decision: WAIT only — historical validation too weak

open_interest.note: Open-interest level only; no historical change inferred.

taker_flow.note: Cross-exchange contract-amount flow proxy, not Binance BTC spot CVD.

orderbook_snapshot.note: Cross-exchange snapshot; not Binance order-book depth.

positioning_interpretation.note: Position buildup is not proof of an imminent liquidation or squeeze.

limitations: Current and short-lookback context only; not historical training features.
Taker buy/sell volume is a CVD proxy, not exchange-wide true CVD.
REST order book is a snapshot, not a live order-book feed.
Deribit fallback fields are cross-exchange BTC perpetual context, not Binance BTCUSDT measurements.

breakout_squeeze_analysis.warning: Context only, not an order or guaranteed prediction. Unconfirmed breaks remain WAIT.

multi_timeframe_trend_alignment.note: EMA alignment is contextual confirmation, not a standalone entry signal.

multi_horizon_consensus.note: Only horizons passing their own validation gate are counted; this is a conflict filter, not a guarantee.

temporal_sequence_model.input_order: 12 consecutive 5m feature vectors; oldest to newest

lstm_sequence_model.class_balancing: sqrt inverse-frequency weighted sampling + capped class-weighted loss
lstm_sequence_model.architecture: 2-layer PyTorch LSTM (48 hidden) + LayerNorm + dense classifier; balanced sequence sampling

matured_feedback_training.note: Only previously matured, matching-schema 15m LSTM forecast windows are used; they are added to the fit fold, never validation or test.

historical_tradeflow_dataset.provider: Binance Vision USD-M aggTrades + Binance kline taker-buy volume
limitations: AggTrade-derived delta is a BTCUSDT taker-flow proxy, not exchange-wide true CVD.
Kline taker-buy volume is used when an aggTrade bucket is unavailable.
Missing flow is explicitly marked unavailable; no future observations are joined.
Historical OI, funding and order-book depth are not included in this dataset.
historical_tradeflow_dataset.note: Full chronological dataset retained; aggTrade features override kline taker-buy proxy where available.

walk_forward_validation.status: EVALUATION ONLY — NOT USED FOR SIGNAL APPROVAL
walk_forward_validation.method: expanding chronological windows; per-fold train-only scaling; purged sequence/label overlap; inner chronological early stopping

temporal_sequence_horizons.method: four independent chronological sequence classifiers; 12 ordered 5m candles

tree_ensemble.validation: chronological holdout with horizon purge; scores are not calibrated win probabilities

advanced_intelligence.method: 2-layer recurrent PyTorch LSTM on 24 ordered candles + temporal MLP + four-horizon chronological ML + Random Forest + gradient boosting + neural MLP + XGBoost (when installed) + volatility regime + liquidity sweep detector

label_threshold.formula: max(0.035%, 20% of trailing 14-candle ATR as a fraction of price)

limitations: When Binance USD-M Futures is unavailable, Kraken BTC/USD spot OHLC is used as a proxy and is not equivalent to BTC/USDT Futures. Funding, open interest, CVD, order book and liquidation remain separate confluence inputs.
Class scores are model scores, not calibrated real-world win probabilities.
Walk-forward metrics are historical diagnostics, not guarantees of future performance.

prediction_feedback.method: multi-horizon forecasts scored against subsequent closed 5m candles
